About

Quietly focused, attentive to the details that matter.

I'm Nima Sarabi, a photographer based in Tartu and working across Estonia. I focus on event, product and food photography — clear, direct images that help clients show their work at its best.

My approach is straightforward. I work quietly, stay focused, and pay attention to the details that matter.

I come from a design and model-making background, where accuracy and clarity matter. That work trains you to notice the small things, and I bring the same discipline into my photography. Clean composition, controlled light, honest documentation.
